svg.title: Figure 01 · Exact GBM paths and discounted European call payoffs
svg.desc: S₀ = K = 100, r = 5%, q = 0, σ = 20%, T = 1; NumPy seed 2026. The simulated paths use exact lognormal transitions. Ten paths illustrate possible model outcomes, not a price estimate.
